text: tlh-gui is a GUI for The Last Harness built as a standalone copy of get-bb/bb, deliberately not a GitHub fork. Diego wants it to stay relatively close to upstream so it keeps benefiting from bb's ongoing development: keep fork deltas small and inventoried, and leave upstream identity and behavior alone unless a delta is explicitly approved.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: The repo is public on purpose (Diego, 2026-10-06). Public repos get unlimited free standard GitHub-hosted runners, which replace upstream's paid Blacksmith runners for fork CI, and the desktop auto-updater fetches release metadata from GitHub release assets without auth, which only works on a public repo. Making it private would break both.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: Diego intends to eventually fork bb's mobile app (apps/mobile) too. Until then apps/mobile, its upstream mobile workflows (disabled in repo settings), and the in-app links to bb's TestFlight/APK stay exactly as upstream ships them; repoint them when the mobile fork happens rather than hiding them now.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: Diego decided (2026-10-06) that tlh-gui launches `tlh` by default for the Pi provider, with no silent fallback to plain `pi` when tlh is missing (show not-installed with TLH install guidance instead). BB_PI_BRIDGE_COMMAND still overrides; any non-tlh command keeps upstream's npm install/update behavior. Install/Update buttons must work with TLH: install runs TLH's release install.sh, update runs `tlh update`. Provider display name stays 'Pi' for now; the internal provider id 'pi' must not change because threads persist it.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: tlh-gui reads the installed TLH version from <agent-dir>/tlh/install-state.json (ref/track) only as a stopgap Diego approved; `tlh --version` reports the private Pi runtime version, not TLH's. The intended replacement is a stable `tlh version --json` contract tracked in diegopetrucci/the-last-harness#746; switch to it once released.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: Diego wants tlh-gui to eventually handle Pi session storage so GUI threads are visible to the tlh CLI; today bb passes its own --session-dir (~/.bb/pi-bridge-sessions) which bb needs for fork/checkpoint. Deferred deliberately, not forgotten. Also deferred as a separate follow-up: bb's native skill-roots listing reads ~/.pi/agent instead of TLH's agent dir.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>
